messages:
Maya (CSE): Quick status: Verdant cutover went okay but they reported missing audit logs for a few subnets. Also the customer is worried about the upcoming renewal — wants a concise ops/usage report.

Jon (Network Eng): I checked — flow logs were never enabled on the transit VPC after the route change. Opened an infra ticket to flip them back on and backfill.

Ava (Security): Noticed a KMS policy mismatch on the rdw-key. Our docs assume the service role has Encrypt/Decrypt but their key policy is more restrictive. I can draft a minimal policy change. @Maya can you confirm Verdant is ok with that?

Maya (CSE): I will confirm with Verdant today. Also they asked whether rotating keys will break anything during a cutover.

Ava (Security): Rotation should be seamless if we roll via alias swap. I'll add the exact CLI/console steps to the runbook and flag the maintenance window recommendation.

Samir (AE): FYI billing flagged the account as 'review' because of a recent usage spike. Renewal convo is next month — execs will want a health summary. We should include risks.

Maya (CSE): Agreed. I'll put together: cutover status, outstanding audit log gaps, KMS fix ETA, IAM role confirmations, and renewal risk notes. Anything else to capture?

Jon (Network Eng): Add SG cleanup — their loadtester added ephemeral wide-open rules. I'll scrub and lock them down, then share the exact firewall diff. ETA ~6 hours.

Maya (CSE): Plan: Jon to enable flow logs + backfill and scrub SGs (ETA 6h), Ava to push KMS policy + runbook updates (ETA 24h), I'll draft the exec one-pager and set a renewal prep sync. @Samir can you join tomorrow 10:00am PT?

Samir (AE): Yep I can. Please include: usage trend chart, 90-day error/latency summary, and cost-per-token estimate. I'll pull the billing and usage.

opsbot: Ticket #CS-9372 created for flow logs backfill. Assigned to Jon. ETA 4h.

Maya (CSE): Customer feedback note: they specifically asked for clearer screenshots in the runbook and a short 30-min enablement session for their SREs. I'll schedule the session once the runbook screenshots are in.

Ava (Security): I'll add annotated screenshots to the KMS section and include the alias-swap CLI snippet. Also will paste the minimal IAM role snippet for the service account.

Maya (CSE): OK closing with action items. I'll drop the one-pager in the Verdant folder and ping this thread when done. Thanks team :pray:
